name: @red-cup-engineering/judge-principal-admission-service
description: Judge one verified identity's admission: resolveAdmissionPolicy turns an authorization server's config (an explicit admitEmail predicate, a single legacy allowedEmail, or neither) into a policy die (email -> boolean); judgePrincipalAdmission applies that die (plus the email-verified claim) to one identity and returns admitted or refused with a reason. Use it right after an upstream IdP confirms who someone is, before minting anything on their behalf.
